title: Denied mourning: The ordeal of the family of Robina Aminian, killed in Iran
summary: Robina Aminian, 23, is one of thousands of victims of the Iranian state's recent crackdown on anti-regime protesters. The young woman was shot in the back of the head on January 8 during a protest in Tehran. Her aunt, living in Norway, spoke to FRANCE 24 about the personal and bureaucratic torment the family was subjected to after her niece’s death.
